<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="ex46032023-02-1416-23-54" type="excerpt" status="unreviewed">
            <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3831">slob dpon cha pa</rs> na re|[ \[]rims kyis [;]rim gyis [\]]don byed pas stong ste| <lb n="25b2"/>skad cig du mas stong ba'i phyir | cig char don byed pas stong ste | skad cig gis stong ba'i phyir | de dag gi phyogs chos ni rtag 'dzin nyams su myong ba'i rang rig mngon sum gyis grub ste | 'di ltar rtag pa ni|
         <lg>
            <l xml:space="preserve">[]<rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">chos kyi grags [\[]pa [;]pa</rs>s [\]]mi rtag pa | </l>
            <l xml:space="preserve">[]log la rtag pa'i tha snyad mdzad | </l>
         </lg>
        zhes gsungs pa dang yang mthun par skad cig mas stong ba tsam la bzhed cing | rang rig gis yul can skad cig mas stong bar 'dzin pa'i 'dzin stangs dngos su [\[p.172-3\]<lb n="25b3"/>\[]bzhal [;]gzhal [\]]ba'i shugs la yul skad cig mas stong bar grub pa na | de'i dngos kyi log phyogs skad cig mas khyad par du byas pa'i skad cig dang skad cig du mas stong bar yang grub pa yin no || 
        ldog khyab ni skad cig ma mngon sum gyis mi grub pa'i gzhan gyis [\[]rims kyis [;]rim gyis [\]]don byed pa la skad cig [\[]pa [;]ma [\]]du mas khyab pa sogs yang mngon sum gyis mi 'grub mod | rjes dpag gis grub ste | 'di ltar [\[]rims kyis [;]rim gyis [\]]don byed pa ni dus [\[p.172-4\]]<lb n="25b4"/>gnyis pa dang | de las gzhan du'ang 'bras bu skyed pa yin zhing | cig char don byed pa ni | dus gnyis pa kho nar 'bras bu skyed pa yin no || 
         []de lta na dus 'di dang dus gzhan tsam chos can | dngos po tha dad yin pas khyab ste | 'gal ba'i chos ldan gyi dngos po yin pas khyab pa'i phyir | dper na sngon po dang sngo min gyi dngos po bzhin no || 
         khyab pa ni dpe'i steng du mngon sum gyis grub bo || phyogs chos kyang dus snga phyi tsam la 'bras bu dang nye [\[p.172-5\]]ring sogs 'du ba 'gal bas khyab pa mngon sum gyis nges so || 
         []de lta na dus snga phyi tsam la dngos po tha dad kyi khyab pa grub pas dus skad cig gis phye ba na yang | skad cig dang po dang gnyis pa sogs dngos po tha dad du grub cing |[ \[]rims kyis [;]rim gyis [\]]don byed pa yang dus du ma dang 'brel bas [\[]rims kyis [;]rim gyis [\]]don byed pa la skad cig ma du mas khyab par grub bo || 
         []cig char gyis don byed pa de la yang | don byed [\[p.172-6\]]pa'i phyi dus gzhan tsam chos can | rgyu 'gags pas khyab ste | 'bras bu skyes pas khyab pa'i phyir | dper na bum pa skyes pa na 'jim pa 'gags pas khyab pa bzhin no || 
         khyab pa dpe'i steng du mngon sum gyis nges so || 
         phyogs chos kyang mngon sum gyis grub bo || de lta na phyi dus gzhan tsam la rgyu 'gags pas khyab pa grub pa na | dus la skad cig gis phye ba na yang skad cig cig char rgyu 'gags pas [\[p.172-7\]]<lb n="25b7"/>khyab pa grub pas cig char don byed pa la skad cig gis khyab pa grub bo zhes gsungs so || </seg></TEI>
